name: TinEye reverse image search
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a commercial API (A8): 'trusted - Google Lens/Maps, Yandex (RU jurisdiction), TinEye, OpenStreetMap Foundation' (P260 cond 5).

reliability.justification: Manual reverse-image or map pages whose content is third-party or user-generated: reliability cannot be judged at provider level (manual links only).

search_url.title: TinEye search?url= (manual reverse-image links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

search_url.notes: Research C0612 terms 'TinEye ToS' (tineye.com/search?url={urlencoded_image_url}; 200 app shell, results fetched client-side; live 2026-11-26). TinEye fetches the image URL server-side (flags.fetches_target): public http(s) image URLs only, never page URLs, file://, data:, private IPs, internal hosts or FILE entities (P260 cond 8). Used by pivots_geo_image.

notes: Seeded by batch p2-G12-1 (P260). Manual links only: V3LUM never requests tineye.com (the commercial API is paid and not used).
